items.title: Third-party test: Tencent's DSpine draft model adds about 16% decoding speed over DFlash2 on Qwen3.8 27B
items.summary: A builder reports tokens per second for Qwen3.8 27B: 253 with plain decoding, 590 with DFlash2 speculative decoding and 686 with Tencent's DSpine draft model. It gives local-inference users a rough sense of what DSpine adds on top of an existing draft setup.
